author: Yffe
content: SHIPPED + critic-clean (167b9f4). The off-corpus clause generator (thermite-tv/src/gen.rs, deterministic SplitMix64, no rand/clock) over the frozen sublanguage (all comparison BinOps, nested connectives, 8 combinators with registry arg-kinds, spec-fn calls, result/old, byteview, casts). Critic confirmed the generated run genuinely DISCHARGES diverse non-trivial obligations (175/200 checked + 25 honest byteview-scope skips; not inflated by trivial obligations). THIS IS THE THESIS PAYOFF: running TV over generated clauses immediately surfaced a REAL off-corpus lowering bug (#146 cast-< mis-parse) the corpus-bounded golden files structurally could not catch.
